unit.label: Travel time, duration & transport
unit.title: How Long Is the Trip?
unit.description: Master the this lesson duration system while repairing real this lesson travel vocabulary gaps, with each recovered item tied back to time, routes, tickets, or trip planning.

goal.pinyin: Wǒmen fàng sān tiān de jià.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 8 Dialogue I–II / Vocabulary I–II (printed pp. 160–165) plus Lesson 9 Dialogue I / Vocabulary I tail and Grammar I–II (printed pp. 182–190). This rebalance restores 非常, 但是, 站, 或是, 便利商店, 公共汽車 and 中國 without disturbing the published Unit 28 step prefixes, while retaining the complete time-duration sequence.

lessons.title: When, Duration & Contrast
lessons.subtitle: Use 影片 to separate when from how long, then connect two ideas with 非常 and 但是.

steps.prompt: Which expression answers “for how long?”
steps.explanation: 兩天 is a duration; 明天 and 今天 tell when.

steps.prompt: Which pair lets you strengthen the first idea and then introduce a contrast?
steps.explanation: 非常 strengthens the description or preference; 但是 introduces the contrasting clause.

lessons.title: Calendar Units & Travel Stations
lessons.subtitle: Use 年, 日, and 天 for time, then place a familiar travel action at 高鐵站.

steps.prompt: Which word means “year”?
steps.explanation: 年 means year; 日 and 天 can both refer to a day in different uses.

steps.prompt: Which word is the day unit in the duration 兩天?
steps.explanation: 天 counts days, 年 counts years, and 鐘頭 counts hours. All three can be duration units.

steps.prompt: In a written date, which character can mean “day of the month”?
steps.explanation: 日 is used as a written date marker; 號 will be introduced with spoken dates next.

steps.prompt: What does 站 mean in 高鐵站?
steps.explanation: 站 means a station or stop.

lessons.title: Hours & Travel Choices
lessons.subtitle: Count hours with 鐘頭, then link two transport alternatives with 或是.

steps.prompt: Which expression means “three hours”?
steps.explanation: 鐘頭 is an hour, so 三個鐘頭 means three hours.
鐘 is zhōng, the first character of 鐘頭.

steps.prompt: Which word links two alternatives as “or”?
steps.explanation: 或是 joins alternatives: A 或是 B.

lessons.title: Study Duration & Ticket Stops
lessons.subtitle: Repeat the verb in an object-duration sentence, then use 便利商店 in a Taiwan ticket-buying context.

steps.prompt: Which sentence follows this lesson's taught object + repeated verb + duration pattern?
steps.explanation: 中文 is the object, and the repeated 學 introduces the duration 一年.

steps.prompt: Why is 學 repeated in 我學中文學一年?
options: 中文 is the object and 一年 is the duration
It makes the sentence a question
It means the action is finished
steps.answer: 中文 is the object and 一年 is the duration
steps.explanation: The first 學 takes 中文; the repeated 學 introduces the duration.

steps.prompt: How is 便 pronounced in 便利商店?
steps.explanation: 便利 is biànlì. This contrasts with 便宜 piányi, where the same character 便 is pronounced pián.

lessons.title: Negative Duration & Bus Travel
lessons.subtitle: Put the duration before negation, then apply the same pattern to 公共汽車.

steps.prompt: Which sentence expresses a two-day negative span with the duration before 不能?
steps.explanation: 兩天 is a duration and is placed before 不能. 明天 is a Time-When expression, while 兩天都來上課 is affirmative.

steps.prompt: In the negative-duration pattern, what comes immediately before 不 or 不能?
steps.explanation: The duration scopes over the length of the negative situation.

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly says “I cannot take the bus for two days”?
options: 我兩天不能坐公共汽車。
我明天不能坐公共汽車。
steps.answer: 我兩天不能坐公共汽車。
steps.explanation: 兩天 gives the duration and comes before 不能; 公共汽車 is bus.

lessons.title: Separable vs. Ordinary Duration
lessons.subtitle: Put time inside 放假 and 唱歌, then contrast that with an ordinary travel-duration sentence.

steps.prompt: Which form puts the duration inside the separable verb 放假, as taught in this lesson?
steps.explanation: The duration 三天 is inserted between 放 and 假.

steps.prompt: Why does 一個星期 follow 旅行 in 我打算去中國旅行一個星期, while 三天 goes inside 放三天的假?
options: 旅行 is an ordinary verb here; 放假 is separable
中國 always forces duration to the end
星期 can only follow country names
steps.answer: 旅行 is an ordinary verb here; 放假 is separable
steps.explanation: Ordinary verb duration follows the verb phrase; a separable verb can take the duration inside its verb-object pair.

lessons.title: Unit 28 Review
lessons.subtitle: Time structure plus the recovered this lesson transport vocabulary.

steps.prompt: Which word means film or video?
steps.explanation: 影片 is film or video.
非 is fēi, the first character of 非常.
年 is nián, year.
汽 is qì, the first character of 汽車.

steps.prompt: Which expression answers “when?” rather than “for how long?”
steps.explanation: 明天 locates the event in time; the others are durations.

steps.prompt: Which word means hour?
steps.explanation: 鐘頭 means hour.

steps.prompt: Which sentence uses the repeated-verb pattern to say “I plan to teach Chinese for two years”?
steps.explanation: 教中文 gives the action and object; 教兩年 repeats the verb and adds its duration.

steps.prompt: Which sentence expresses a two-day negative span with duration before 不能?
steps.explanation: 兩天 is the duration and comes before 不能.

steps.prompt: Which pair gives two valid ways to say “have two days off”?
options: 放假兩天的／放兩天的假
放假的兩天／放假兩天的
steps.explanation: In the taught separable-verb pattern, 的 may be present or absent between duration and 假.

steps.prompt: Which component is on the left of 但?
steps.explanation: 但 has 亻 on the left and 旦 on the right.

steps.prompt: Which character can mark a day in a written date?
steps.explanation: 日 is used for a written day/date.

steps.prompt: Which word means “China”?
steps.explanation: 中國 is China; 古代 means ancient times, and 臺灣 is Taiwan.

steps.prompt: How is 便 pronounced in 便利商店, compared with 便宜?
options: biàn in 便利商店; pián in 便宜
steps.answer: biàn in 便利商店; pián in 便宜
steps.explanation: 便利 is biànlì, while 便宜 is piányi. The same character has different readings in these two familiar words.

steps.prompt: Which is the full expression for “bus” taught here?
steps.explanation: 公共汽車 is bus; 計程車 is taxi and 機車 is scooter/motorcycle.

steps.prompt: Which word correctly links two transport alternatives as “or”?
steps.explanation: 或是 links alternatives: 坐高鐵或是坐火車.

steps.prompt: Which statement correctly contrasts the two time types?
options: Time-when locates an event; duration gives its length
Duration always comes before the subject
steps.answer: Time-when locates an event; duration gives its length
steps.explanation: That is the core this lesson distinction.

steps.prompt: Which sentence means “I really like films, but I do not have time to watch today”?
options: 我非常喜歡影片，但是今天沒有空看。
我非常喜歡影片，今天也有空看。
我今天不喜歡影片，但是有空看。
steps.answer: 我非常喜歡影片，但是今天沒有空看。
steps.explanation: 非常 strengthens 喜歡, while 但是 introduces the contrast with 今天沒有空看.

steps.prompt: Which set correctly matches the recovered travel words?
options: 站 = station；便利商店 = convenience store；公共汽車 = bus
站 = station；便利商店 = tea house；公共汽車 = taxi
站 = market；便利商店 = convenience store；公共汽車 = scooter
steps.answer: 站 = station；便利商店 = convenience store；公共汽車 = bus
steps.explanation: 站 is station, 便利商店 is convenience store, and 公共汽車 is bus.

newVocabulary.note: The character was already known from 今天/明天; this is its first standalone vocabulary teaching.
Taiwan term used here for convenience store. Pronounce 便 as biàn here; compare 便宜 piányi, where 便 is pián.
this lesson gives 公共汽車 as the full form and 公車 as the shorter everyday form.

年.note: 年 is second-tone nián and names a year or a duration measured in years.
年.memory: The six strokes interlock around a central vertical; keep the middle horizontals distinct before the final vertical finish.

parts.label: upper
parts.name: upper strokes
parts.description: The first two strokes establish the upper-left and top horizontal of 年.

parts.label: middle
parts.name: middle cross
parts.description: The next two strokes build the central horizontal-and-vertical structure.

parts.label: lower
parts.name: lower finish
parts.description: The last two strokes complete the lower bar and final vertical.

日.note: 日 is fourth-tone rì. In dates it can mean day of the month, as in 三十日.
日.memory: 日 is a tall box with one inner horizontal; the bottom edge closes the frame last.

parts.label: 囗
parts.name: outer frame
parts.description: The outer frame uses the first two strokes and the final closing stroke; the bottom is written last.

parts.label: 一
parts.name: inner horizontal
parts.description: The third stroke is the short horizontal inside the frame.

日.partOrderLabel: outer sides, inner line, then close the bottom

鐘.meaning: clock; bell; hour in 鐘頭
鐘.note: 鐘 is first-tone zhōng. In 鐘頭, the whole word means an hour.
鐘.memory: 金 fills the left eight strokes and 童 fills the right twelve; keep the dense right side tall and narrow.

parts.label: 金
parts.name: metal component
parts.description: The first eight strokes form 金 on the left.

parts.label: 童
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final twelve strokes form 童 on the right.

頭.meaning: head; final character of 鐘頭
頭.note: 頭 is second-tone tóu. In 鐘頭 it completes the everyday word for an hour.
頭.memory: 豆 takes the first seven strokes on the left and 頁 takes the last nine on the right.

parts.label: 豆
parts.name: left component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 豆 on the left.

parts.label: 頁
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The last nine strokes form 頁 on the right.

非.meaning: not; non-; first character of 非常
非.note: 非 is first-tone fēi. In 非常, it forms the common adverb meaning “very.”
非.memory: Write the left vertical and its three short bars first, then the right vertical and its three bars. The halves face outward and are written consecutively.

parts.label: left half
parts.name: left comb-like group
parts.description: The first four strokes are the left vertical followed by three bars extending left. This is a visual group, not a separate character.

parts.label: right half
parts.name: right comb-like group
parts.description: The last four strokes are the right vertical followed by three bars extending right.

但.meaning: but; however; first character of 但是
但.note: 但 is fourth-tone dàn. In 但是, it introduces a contrast: “but; however.”
但.memory: 亻stands on the left; 旦 on the right has 日 over a final horizontal.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: person component
parts.description: The first two strokes form 亻 on the left.

parts.label: 旦
parts.name: dawn component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 旦 on the right: 日 above the bottom horizontal.

站.note: 站 is fourth-tone zhàn. In 高鐵站, it means a station or stop.
站.memory: 立 takes the left five strokes and 占 takes the right five; keep both halves narrow.

parts.label: 立
parts.name: stand component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 立 on the left.

parts.label: 占
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 占 on the right.

或.meaning: or; perhaps; first character of 或是
或.note: 或 is fourth-tone huò. In 或是, it means “or.”
或.memory: The 戈-like outer strokes wrap around 口 and 一. Because the wrapping strokes are interleaved with the inside, learn 或 as one ordered whole rather than a fake side-by-side split.

parts.label: 或
parts.name: wrapped whole form
parts.description: The eight strokes combine an outer 戈-like frame with the inner 口 and 一 in interleaved stroke order.

利.meaning: benefit; second character of 便利
利.note: 利 is fourth-tone lì. In 便利商店, 便利 is biànlì, “convenient”; note that 便 is biàn here but pián in 便宜.
利.memory: 禾 is the five-stroke left side; the two-stroke 刂 blade finishes the right edge.

parts.label: 禾
parts.name: grain component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 禾 on the left.

parts.label: 刂
parts.name: knife side
parts.description: The last two strokes form 刂 on the right.

汽.meaning: steam; first character of 汽車
汽.note: 汽 is fourth-tone qì. In 公共汽車, 汽車 contributes the vehicle/bus meaning.
汽.memory: Three water dots 氵go on the left; 气 fills the right with four strokes.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water side
parts.description: The first three strokes form 氵 on the left.

parts.label: 气
parts.name: air component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 气 on the right.

u28-when-duration-contrast.title: When something happens vs. how long it lasts
u28-when-duration-contrast.explanation: Time-When expressions locate an event at a point or period on the calendar, while Time-Duration expressions give the length of the action. In the basic patterns here, a when-expression appears before the action, while a duration follows the verb.

examples.meaning: I want to be away / have fun for two days.

u28-when-duration-contrast.remember: Ask whether the expression answers “when?” or “for how long?” before deciding its position.

u28-object-duration.title: Repeat the verb when a duration follows an object
u28-object-duration.explanation: When the verb has an object and you also state how long the activity lasts, repeat the verb before the duration. The first verb takes the object; the repeated verb introduces the length of time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xué Zhōngwén xué yì nián.
examples.meaning: I study Chinese for one year.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiāo Zhōngwén jiāo yì nián.
examples.meaning: I teach Chinese for one year.

u28-object-duration.remember: In this repeated-verb pattern: verb + object + the same verb + duration. Other duration patterns are taught separately.

u28-duration-negation.title: Put the duration before a negated action
u28-duration-negation.explanation: When the duration tells how long a negative situation lasts, the duration comes before 不 or 不能. This is different from the basic affirmative pattern where the duration follows the verb. Here the examples describe a planned or expected period of inability. They do not mean that the action itself takes two days, and they are not the past-time “have not done it for…” construction.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ liǎng tiān bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.meaning: I cannot come to class for two days.

examples.text: 我一個星期不能去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge xīngqí bù néng qù lǚxíng.
examples.meaning: I cannot travel for one week.

u28-duration-negation.remember: For a negative span, say the duration first, then the negation.

u28-separable-duration.title: Insert duration into a separable verb
u28-separable-duration.explanation: With a separable verb, the duration can go between the verb and its object. this lesson shows both forms with and without 的. 放假 can become 放三天的假, and 唱歌 can become 唱三個鐘頭的歌.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fàng sān tiān de jià.
Wǒ chàng sān ge zhōngtóu de gē.

u28-separable-duration.remember: 放三天假 and 放三天的假 both work: duration goes between 放 and 假; 的 is optional here.

u28-film.note: 影片 is the this lesson word for film or video.

u28-two-days.meaning: I want to be away / have fun for two days.
u28-two-days.note: 兩天 is a duration and follows 玩.

u28-one-year.pinyin: Wǒ xué Zhōngwén xué yì nián.
u28-one-year.meaning: I study Chinese for one year.
u28-one-year.note: The verb 學 repeats because 中文 is an object before the duration.

u28-two-days-no-class.pinyin: Wǒ liǎng tiān bù néng lái shàngkè.
u28-two-days-no-class.meaning: I cannot come to class for two days.
u28-two-days-no-class.note: The duration 兩天 appears before the negation 不能.

u28-three-day-break.pinyin: Wǒmen fàng sān tiān de jià.
u28-three-day-break.note: 放假 is separable here: 放 + 三天的 + 假.

u28-three-hours-song.pinyin: Wǒ chàng sān ge zhōngtóu de gē.
u28-three-hours-song.note: 唱歌 is separable: 唱 + duration + 的 + 歌.

u28-very-but.text: 我非常喜歡影片，但是今天沒有空看。
u28-very-but.pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuān yǐngpiàn, dànshì jīntiān méiyǒu kòng kàn.
u28-very-but.meaning: I really like films, but I do not have time to watch today.
u28-very-but.note: 非常 strengthens 喜歡; 但是 introduces the contrast. 今天 is a Time-When expression.

u28-station.text: 我星期日去高鐵站買票。
u28-station.pinyin: Wǒ xīngqírì qù gāotiě zhàn mǎi piào.
u28-station.meaning: I go to the HSR station to buy a ticket on Sunday.
u28-station.note: 星期日 is a Time-When expression; 站 names the travel station.

u28-or.text: 坐高鐵或是坐火車都可以。
u28-or.pinyin: Zuò gāotiě huòshì zuò huǒchē dōu kěyǐ.
u28-or.meaning: Taking the HSR or taking the train are both possible.
u28-or.note: 或是 links alternatives: A or B.

u28-convenience.pinyin: Wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi piào.
u28-convenience.meaning: I buy a ticket at a convenience store.
u28-convenience.note: 便利商店 is the Taiwan term used here for convenience store. Here 便 is pronounced biàn in 便利, unlike pián in 便宜.

u28-ticket-options.text: 在高鐵站或是便利商店都可以。
u28-ticket-options.pinyin: Zài gāotiě zhàn huòshì biànlì shāngdiàn dōu kěyǐ.
u28-ticket-options.meaning: Either at an HSR station or at a convenience store is fine.
u28-ticket-options.note: This combines the this lesson ticket-buying locations with 或是.

u28-bus.text: 我兩天不能坐公共汽車。
u28-bus.pinyin: Wǒ liǎng tiān bù néng zuò gōnggòng qìchē.
u28-bus.meaning: I cannot take the bus for two days.
u28-bus.note: The duration 兩天 comes before 不能. 公共汽車 is the full form for bus taught here.

u28-china-ancient.text: 我打算去中國旅行一個星期。
u28-china-ancient.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù Zhōngguó lǚxíng yí ge xīngqí.
u28-china-ancient.meaning: I plan to travel in China for one week.
u28-china-ancient.note: 旅行 is an ordinary verb here, so 一個星期 follows the verb phrase. Compare 放三天的假, where the duration goes inside the separable verb 放假.
